content: import urllib.request, re, html, sys url = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'https://www.turbinist.ru/' data = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=15).read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace') text = data for cls in ['turbo-static-text', 'full-article-content', 'story-full-text']: m = re.search(rf']*class="[^"]*{cls}[^"]*"[^>]*>', data, re.DOTALL) if m: start = m.end() end = data.find('', start) end2 = data.find('', end + 1) if end > 0 else -1 text = data[start:end2] if end2 > start else data[start:start+20000] break for tag in ['br', 'p', 'li', 'tr', 'th', 'td', 'div', 'h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'h4']: text = re.sub(rf'<{tag}\s*/?>', chr(10), text) text = re.sub(rf'', chr(10), text) text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text) text = html.unescape(text) text = re.sub(r'\n{3,}', chr(10)*2, text) text = re.sub(r'[ \t]+', ' ', text) text = re.sub(r'\n[ \t]+', chr(10), text) print(text.strip())
